title: Dwelling Release Figure — Insurance Claim Services Calculation Clause
content:
**Clause.** On an Insurance Claim Services file, the release figure of the insured's dwelling release is the dwelling holdback less each deduction taken from it, the incurred-cost shortfall among them, the deductions being independent of one another; the figure is never below zero and is rounded to the cent, half up, once, on the final figure, with a tolerance of one billionth of a dollar (1e-09) added before that rounding.

1. **Dwelling holdback.** The depreciation withheld on every dwelling scope approval of the file, less the depreciation release carrier payments received on the dwelling coverage and less every write-off posted on the file's approvals, never below zero.
2. **Incurred-cost shortfall.** The expected dwelling approvals less the billed cost, never below zero.
3. **Expected approvals.** The dwelling approvals as recorded plus the amounts requested on dwelling scope omission and price variance supplements awaiting the carrier's decision, because a pending supplement is settled against the same approvals once decided and the release pays depreciation only on scope that was billed.
4. **Billed cost.** The contract cost plus the water job cost.
5. **Contract cost.** The contract amount plus the change order charges and less the change order credits posted on the Reconstruction contract.
6. **Water job cost.** Every charge posted on the Water Damage Mitigation job other than late fees and card surcharges.

## Worked figure (hypothetical file)

| Item | Amount |
|---|---|
| depreciation withheld on the dwelling approvals | 6400.00 |
| depreciation release payments received (dwelling) | 0.00 |
| write-offs posted on the file's approvals | 350.00 |
| **dwelling holdback** | **6050.00** |
| dwelling approvals as recorded | 52000.00 |
| pending dwelling scope omission and price variance requests | 1800.00 |
| expected approvals | 53800.00 |
| contract amount 40000.00, change order charges 2380.00, change order credits 1200.00 | contract cost 41180.00 |
| water job charges 10150.00, of which a late fee of 250.00 and a card surcharge of 100.00 | water job cost 9800.00 |
| billed cost | 50980.00 |
| **incurred-cost shortfall** | **2820.00** |

Release figure: 6050.00 less 2820.00, **3230.00**. Had the billed cost been 54000.00, the shortfall would be 0.00 (never below zero) and the release figure 6050.00.
